outcome: Risk of interstitial cystitis/painful bladder syndrome (IC/PBS)
cohort: Women who gave birth via cesarean section or vaginal delivery between 2002 and 2013
finding: Cesarean section was not found to be a risk factor for developing interstitial cystitis/painful bladder syndrome (IC/PBS) after controlling for confounding factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was not found to have a causal effect on interstitial cystitis/painful bladder syndrome compared to vaginal delivery.
